properties.name: pcis.batch.oauth2.token-uri
properties.description: OAuth2 token endpoint URI for client-credentials grant.

properties.name: pcis.batch.oauth2.client-id
properties.description: OAuth2 client identifier for the batch workload.

properties.name: pcis.batch.oauth2.client-secret-ref
properties.description: ARN or placeholder reference to the client secret in the managed secret store (never plaintext in yaml).

properties.name: pcis.batch.oauth2.scope
properties.description: Optional OAuth2 scope requested for the batch workload token.

properties.name: pcis.batch.oauth2.expiration-buffer-seconds
properties.description: Seconds before token expiry to proactively refresh the cached access token.
